user.title: Set up Automationscheck
user.description: Checks your automations and scripts for loops, conflicting automations and broken trigger IDs. Findings appear under Settings → Repairs. Nothing is changed.

data_description.show_notes: Notes are possible but uncertain problems, e.g. loops that depend on values only known at runtime.
data_description.include_disabled: Disabled automations do not run, so they cannot cause conflicts.

run.name: Check now
run.description: Checks all automations and scripts right away and returns the findings.

not_loaded.message: Automationscheck is not set up or not loaded.

conflict.title: Conflict: {automation_a} and {automation_b}

loop.title: Loop: {automations}

self_trigger.title: Self-trigger: {automation}

unknown_trigger_id.title: Unknown trigger ID in {automation}
unknown_trigger_id.description:
A condition in **{automation}** checks the trigger ID **{ids}**, which does not exist there (defined: {defined}). That branch will never run.

Fix the ID in the trigger or in the condition.

idle_trigger.title: Trigger without effect in {automation}
idle_trigger.description:
**{automation}** starts on these triggers, but no branch reacts to them: **{ids}**.

Remove the triggers or add a matching branch.
